tagline: We make managing a trademark effortless.

status.title: Meesam is being built
status.body: This is the pilot environment. The platform opens on 2 December 2026.

registries.label: Registries available
registries.pilot: UAE — MoET (first), with UK, EUIPO, USPTO and GCC registries to follow

who.title: Who are you?
who.lead: Choose the account that fits. A person who is both an owner and an agent holds two logins.

individual.title: Individual owner
individual.body: You own trademarks in your own name.

company.title: Company owner
company.body: Your company owns trademarks; add trademark managers later.

agency.title: Agency office
agency.body: A licensed trademark agency acting for its clients.

who.leadInvited: You were invited by an agency. Choose the owner account that fits; the request will be waiting once your account is verified.

agency.title: Create an agency office account
agency.listingNote: Directory listing is off until your licence is verified by Meesam.

register.uploadLater: Document upload is added when the vault opens; the reference is enough to start verification.
register.legal: By creating an account you accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.

errors.required: Please fill in every required field.
errors.email: That e-mail address does not look right.
errors.password: The password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.exists: An account with this e-mail already exists. Log in instead.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

checkEmail.title: Check your e-mail
checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address; the link is valid for 24 hours.

ok.title: E-mail confirmed
ok.body: Thank you. Your account is now being verified by Meesam. Log in to follow its status.

bad.title: This link is not valid
bad.body: It may have expired or been used already. Log in and request a new one.

errors.invalid: The e-mail or password is not right.
errors.unverifiedEmail: Please confirm your e-mail address first — we sent you a link.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.expired: The sign-in took too long or had too many wrong codes. Please log in again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your e-mail; if it belongs to an account we will send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password is set. Log in with it.
reset.bad: This reset link is not valid or has expired.

pending_email.label: Waiting for e-mail confirmation
pending_email.body: Open the link we sent to {email}.

pending_review.label: Under review by Meesam
pending_review.body: Your identity or registration reference is being checked. This usually completes within one working day; you will receive an e-mail when the account is active.

rejected.label: Verification not completed
rejected.body: We could not verify the details given. Reply to the e-mail you received or contact support.

steps.review: Details reviewed by Meesam staff or AI
steps.active: Account activated — you are notified by e-mail

help.title: Help
help.body: Only technical and payment issues reach a human; everything else is self-service with the assistant.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: Nothing to show yet. Add an existing trademark or request a new filing to start.

pendingKinds.appointments: {n} appointment request(s) waiting for your answer

dashboard.nextDatesSub: From each registry profile, by days remaining.
dashboard.confirmSub: Meesam never asserts a registry fact: suggested stage changes, computed statuses and unentered deadlines wait for you.
dashboard.noticePilot: Pilot opens 2 December 2026: your whole portfolio loads free and is watched free for the pilot's duration.
dashboard.portfolioSub: Click a stage to filter the portfolio. Stages 6, 8 and 9 count flags.

errors.readOnly: Your role is Viewer: you can read records and download documents, but not change them.

verify.subject: Confirm your e-mail for Meesam
verify.body:
Hello {name},

Confirm your e-mail address to continue creating your Meesam account:
{link}

The link is valid for 24 hours. If you did not create an account, ignore this message.

Meesam

reset.subject: Reset your Meesam password
reset.body:
Hello {name},

Use this link to choose a new password:
{link}

The link is valid for one hour. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message.

Meesam

verified.subject: Your Meesam account is active
verified.body:
Hello {name},

Your account has been verified and is now active. Log in to add your trademarks:
{link}

Meesam

rejected.subject: Your Meesam account could not be verified

invite.subject: You are invited to {account} on Meesam
invite.body:
Hello {name},

{by} invited you to join {account} on Meesam, the trademark management platform. Choose a password to activate your login:
{link}

The link is valid for 7 days. If you were not expecting this, ignore this message.

Meesam

requested.subject: {from} sent you an appointment request on Meesam

accepted.subject: {from} accepted your appointment request
accepted.body:
Hello {name},

{from} accepted your appointment request on Meesam. The trademarks in scope are now shared.

{link}

Meesam

declined.subject: {from} declined your appointment request

ended.subject: {from} ended the appointment
ended.body:
Hello {name},

{from} ended the appointment on Meesam. Access to the trademarks it covered has stopped.

{link}

Meesam

scope.subject: {from} changed the trademarks you manage
scope.body:
Hello {name},

{from} changed which trademarks your appointment covers on Meesam.

{link}

Meesam

message.subject: New message from {from} about {mark}

pass.subject: {agency} sent you a Meesam pass for {mark}
pass.body:
Hello,

{agency} manages the trademark {mark} for you and has entered it in Meesam, the trademark management platform. This pass attaches the trademark to your own Meesam account, where you can see its dates, documents and status.

Pass code: {code}

Open the pass (you will be asked to log in or create an owner account first):
{link}

The pass can be used once and is valid for 30 days.

Meesam

takenBack.subject: {agency} took back the trademark {mark}
takenBack.body:
Hello {name},

{agency} has taken back the trademark {mark}, which it had attached to your Meesam account with an owner pass. The trademark is no longer in your portfolio. If you believe this is a mistake, contact {agency}.

{link}

Meesam

loginCode.subject: {code} is your Meesam sign-in code

ownerInvite.subject: {agency} invites you to Meesam
ownerInvite.body:
Hello,

{agency} would like to manage your trademarks with you on Meesam, the trademark management platform, and has sent you an appointment request.
Message: {note}

Create your owner account with this e-mail address to see the request. You choose which trademarks the agency manages, and you can decline:
{link}

If you did not expect this message you can ignore it.

Meesam

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.empty: No records yet. Add an existing trademark to start.
portfolio.sub: Every record you own, whoever created it. Primary sort: stage.
portfolio.noMatch: Clear a filter to see more records.

intake.title: Add an existing trademark

manager.self: Self — the owner deals with the registry directly
manager.noAgency: You have no appointed agency yet; you can appoint one later and the record follows the appointment.

intake.registryNote: Only registries whose rules Meesam has verified are open. More follow as each is verified.
intake.imageLater: Upload the mark image as a document in step 5; image comparison for the watch reads it from there.
intake.classesHint: Hover a number for the class heading. Classes 1–34 goods, 35–45 services.
intake.goodsHint: Keep the wording as it appears on the filing; the current Nice edition is shown for reference only.
intake.oppositionEndHint: Leave empty to compute it from the registry's rules.
intake.expiryHint: As printed on the certificate; checked against the registry's term.

documents.title: Documents
documents.lead: Upload the copies you hold. For an existing mark the certificate and the power of attorney are the minimum set.
documents.aiLater: Reading of the documents to pre-fill fields arrives with the document reader; today the fields are typed and the documents stored.
documents.fileHint: PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP or TIFF, up to 25 MB.
documents.leadFirst: Start with the registration certificate (or the latest registry document you hold). Meesam reads it and fills the next steps; you check every value before anything is saved. You can also skip this and type everything yourself.
documents.continueRead: The next steps are pre-filled from the documents; check and correct them.
documents.continueManual: No document yet — the next steps are typed by hand.

review.lead: Every field below is what will be saved. Change anything that is wrong; confirm anything the checks flag that is nevertheless correct.
review.warningsLead: These checks are advisory — they never block saving. Correct the field, or confirm it with a short note; the note is kept with the record and the flag stays visible until cleared.
review.confirmPlaceholder: e.g. Date as on the certificate
review.accept: I have reviewed every field and accept the record as shown.
review.afterwards: Next dates are computed from the accepted dates; the watch starts once the record is paid.
review.readLead: {n} value(s) were read from your documents; each shows the passage it came from. Accepting saves them as your entries.

errors.markText: Enter the mark text in at least one script (or choose a device mark).
errors.fileType: That file type is not accepted.
errors.fileSize: The file is empty or larger than 25 MB.
errors.vault: The document could not be stored. Try again.
errors.accept: Tick the acceptance box to create the record.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notices.yearFixed: A two-digit year was read as 20xx — please check the dates before continuing.
notices.read: {n} field(s) were read from the document. They are marked "Read by AI" on the next steps — check each one.
notices.readNothing: The document was read but no usable field was found; continue by hand.
notices.readFailed: The document could not be read; continue by hand (the file is kept).
notices.noReader: Document reading is not active on this server; continue by hand.

checks.filing_after_later: The filing date is after the {later} — a mark cannot be filed after it was accepted, published or registered.
checks.registration_before_opposition_end: Registration is dated before the opposition window closed ({window_end}).
checks.expiry_mismatch: Expiry does not match the registry's term of {years} years (expected {expected}).
checks.future_date: This date is in the future for a stage already reached.
checks.class_out_of_range: Class {class} is outside the Nice range 1–45.
checks.missing_for_stage: Not provided for the stage reached.
checks.number_format: The number does not match this registry's format.

record.created: The record was created. Next dates are computed from the accepted dates.
record.enterDeadline: Enter the deadline (the registry's period is not yet verified):
record.agenciesLater: Appointments, owner passes and cross-border instructions arrive in the next step.
record.watchOff: Watch is off until the record is paid.
record.watchLater: Watch settings and alerts arrive with the watch pipeline.
record.heading: Class heading
record.validUntilHint: For a power of attorney: its expiry date.
record.readOnly: Read only — this record is held under an appointment you cannot edit, or is unpaid.
record.certificateNote: Changes are audited and the other side is notified.

madrid.title: Madrid / WIPO
madrid.none: Not a Madrid filing. A basis or designation would be noted here with the international registration number, designations, central renewal date and the five-year dependency.

stageChange.title: Record a stage change
stageChange.registryStatusHint: Exactly as the registry writes it; shown beside Meesam's stage.
stageChange.note: The event is added to the timeline, timers are recomputed from the registry's rules, and the other side is notified.
stageChange.agencyNotified: {name} holds this record and sees your change in its timeline. Both of you edit; each is notified of the other's change.

fee.payLater: Payment arrives with the payment gateway ruling.
fee.title: Record fee

basisText.free_new_pending: New mark: free until the certificate; full price then.
basisText.free_loaded: Existing mark loaded free: years remaining counted from the day the watch is switched on; a part year counts as a full year.
basisText.read_only_unpaid: New mark: full price due at the certificate.
basisText.paid: Years remaining at entry; a part year counts as a full year.

errors.event: Choose an event and a valid date.
errors.fileType: That file type is not accepted.
errors.fileSize: The file is empty or larger than 25 MB.
errors.vault: The document could not be stored. Try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.imageType: The image must be PNG, JPG or WebP.
errors.imageSize: The image is empty or larger than 5 MB.
errors.markText: Enter the mark's wording in at least one script (a device mark may have none).
errors.classRange: A class number must be between 1 and 45.

record.noImage: No image on file. A word mark needs none; a device or combined mark should carry the image as filed.
record.imageHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB — the representation as it appears on the certificate. Replacing keeps the earlier file in the vault.
record.imageWhy: This image is the mark's reference representation: it is what the publication watch compares against new publications and what appears in reports. For a word mark it is optional; for a device or combined mark it should be the exact representation on the certificate, cropped to the mark, on a plain background.
record.imageHow: To change it, upload a new file below; the new image becomes the reference at once and the earlier file remains in the Documents tab as history.
record.eventNote: Stages 6, 8 and 9 run beside a registered mark
record.nextDatesSub: Computed from the registry profile; each day ends 23:59 {tz}.
record.poaBody: Upload the power of attorney on the Documents tab so the agency can act before the registry.
record.noDocumentsBody: Upload the registry's notices and certificates.
record.timelineSub: Every event and edit, with the account that made it.

banners.unpaidTitle: Read-only · payment due since the certificate was recorded
banners.unpaidBody: Data and documents stay visible; edits and the watch start after payment.
banners.closedBody: Kept in the portfolio, read-only and off the watch.

record.checksSub: Advisory only: nothing is blocked. Fix the value on the Certificate tab, or confirm it is correct as it stands.
record.editMarkSub: Mark type and wording as on the certificate. For a device or combined mark, also upload the image below.
record.classesEditSub: Correct the class number or the goods and services as filed.
record.classesNoAdd: Corrections only. Adding a class is a separate, paid step.

request.title: Filing request
request.sub: The request as accepted. Print it or save it as PDF to file with the registry or hand to your agency.
request.bannerTitle: Filing request prepared · not yet filed
request.bannerBody: File it with the registry (or through your agency), then record the application number and filing date; the record moves to stage 2.

messages.sub: Messages between you and {other} about this trademark. Text only; each message also appears on the timeline.
messages.noAgency: Messages open when an agency manages this trademark. Appoint one from Agencies.
messages.note: The other side is told by e-mail.
messages.viewer: Your role is Viewer: you can read messages but not send them.

errors.messageNoAgency: No agency manages this trademark at the moment, so there is nobody to write to.
errors.messagePick: Tick at least one agency to send the message to.

pass.title: Owner pass
pass.sub: You entered this trademark for a client. A pass lets the owner attach it to their own Meesam account; your office goes on managing it. One use, valid 30 days.
pass.codeOnce: Pass code (shown once, for the next few minutes)
pass.email: Owner's e-mail (the pass is sent there and only that address can use it)
pass.rules: Leave the e-mail empty for a code you hand over yourself; any verified owner account holding it can use it.
pass.replaces: A new pass stops the current one working.

saved.pass: Pass issued. Give the code below to the owner.
saved.passSent: Pass issued and e-mailed to the owner.
saved.passNoMail: Pass issued, but the e-mail could not be sent. Give the code below to the owner.
saved.passTakenBack: The trademark is back in your office's account. The owner has been told. You can issue a new pass.

errors.pass: The pass could not be issued.
errors.passEmail: Enter a valid e-mail address, or leave it empty.
errors.passTakeBack: This trademark cannot be taken back. That is possible only for a trademark your office handed over by pass and still manages.

pass.overviewTitle: Your office holds this trademark for a client
pass.overviewBody: The owner does not have it in their own Meesam account yet. An owner pass lets them attach it; your office goes on managing it.
pass.takeBackSub: This trademark was attached to {owner} with an owner pass your office issued. If it went to the wrong account, you can take it back into your office's own account.
pass.takeBackConfirm: I understand that {owner} loses this trademark and everything on its record, and that the appointment for it ends.

record.priorityClaimed: Priority is claimed from an earlier application
record.priorityClaimedHint: Tick this only if the application claims priority. It opens the registry's deadline for filing the priority document.
record.registryCheckDo: I checked this against the registry
record.registryCheckHint: A statement by the user, not a check by Meesam. It is withdrawn automatically if the numbers or dates on the certificate information change.

settings.title: Account
settings.accountNote: Changes are recorded in the audit log.
settings.fixedNote: these were verified with the account and are changed through support.
settings.adminOnly: Only the account administrator can change these details.
settings.emailNote: The sign-in e-mail cannot be changed here; contact support.
settings.passwordNote: Other devices are signed out when the password changes.

saved.totp: Authenticator app set up. From now on Meesam asks for its code when you sign in.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.passwordShort: The new password is too short.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
errors.adminOnly: Only the account administrator can change the account details.
errors.logoSize: The logo is empty or larger than 2 MB.
errors.imageType: The image must be PNG, JPG or WebP.
errors.vault: The file could not be stored. Please try again.

settings.logoWhy: Your logo appears in the top bar and, later, on reports and on documents Meesam prepares for you. It is seen only by your own users.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB; a wide version on a plain or transparent background works best.

directory.title: Directory listing
directory.why: When listed, verified owners can find your office in Meesam's directory and send appointment requests. Your office name, country, city and website are shown.

twofactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twofactor.required: Required for your role: after your password, Meesam asks for a code. Without an authenticator app the code is sent to your e-mail.
twofactor.on: On: after your password, Meesam asks for a code.
twofactor.optional: Optional for your role. When on, Meesam asks for a code after your password.
twofactor.emailOn: Sent to {email} when you sign in without the app
twofactor.appWhy: An authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password and others) gives the code without waiting for an e-mail.
twofactor.step1: 1. In your authenticator app, add an account and enter this key (or open the link on the phone that has the app).
twofactor.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows
twofactor.badCode: That code does not match. Check the time on your phone is set automatically, then try the code now showing.
twofactor.removeNote: After removal the code is sent by e-mail.
twofactor.optOn: Switch on two-step sign-in (code by e-mail)

filing.title: Request a new filing
filing.applicantLead: Pre-filled from your account; change anything the application should state differently.
filing.legalFormHint: For example: individual, limited liability company, sole establishment.
filing.rulesNote: These are the registry's own rules, shown for your information. Meesam does not block anything on them.
filing.routeSelfNote: You take the prepared request, file it with the registry yourself, and record the application number and filing date here.
filing.routeAgencyNote: The request goes to your agency, which files it and records the application number. Sending the request to an agency inside Meesam arrives with appointments; until then, hand over the printed request.
filing.agencyNamedHint: Optional; for your own reference until the agency is appointed in Meesam.
filing.transliterationHint: How the mark is pronounced, in the other script.
filing.colourClaimHint: Leave empty when the mark is filed in black and white.
filing.imageHint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 5 MB, as it will be filed.
filing.imageNote: Needed for a device or combined mark.
filing.classesLead: Choose the Nice classes (13th edition, 2026). For each class, either claim the class heading or write the goods and services to be covered.
filing.classesRefresh: Show goods boxes for the chosen classes
filing.classesRefreshNote: Tick the classes, then press this to get one box per class.
filing.useHeading: Claim the class heading as it stands
filing.priorityLead: Only when this application claims the date of an earlier filing in another country.
filing.priorityYes: Yes, from an earlier foreign filing
filing.attachmentsLead: Attach what the registry's form asks for. A power of attorney is needed when an agency files; a trade licence for a UAE company.
filing.declarationAccuracy: I declare that the information in this request is correct and that the applicant is entitled to file it.
filing.reviewLead: This is the request as it will be kept. Change anything that is wrong, then accept.
filing.checksLead: Advisory only: nothing is blocked. Fix the point or note why it stands.
filing.notDone: Meesam prepares the request; it does not file, sign, pay or advise, and it does not search the register for conflicts.
filing.accept: I have reviewed the request and accept it as the applicant's instruction.

checks.goodsMissing: No goods or services written and the class heading is not claimed.
checks.priorityIncomplete: A priority claim needs the country, the number and the date.
checks.future: The date is in the future.
checks.priorityOld: The earlier filing is more than six months old; priority may no longer be available.

errors.accept: Tick the box to accept the request.
errors.incomplete: The registry and the mark type are needed before the request can be created.
errors.duplicate: A record for this mark already exists at this registry.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

terms.search: Search the Nice list for class {n}
terms.none: No term matches. You can type the goods or services yourself.
terms.edition: Nice Classification, 13th edition, list in force today (WIPO). Picking a term adds it to the box above; you can still edit the text.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.sub: Verification before activation: an account becomes active only after this review.
accounts.pendingNone: No account is waiting for review.
accounts.note: Note to the account (optional for approval, required for rejection)

saved.approved: Account approved; its users have been told by e-mail.
saved.rejected: Account rejected; its users have been told by e-mail.

errors.noteRequired: A rejection needs a note telling the account what to correct.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

staff.title: Staff
staff.sub: People who hold a staff role. Staff use a separate staff login, never the login of an owner or agency account. Two-step sign-in is required for every staff login.
staff.inviteSub: The person receives an e-mail with a link to choose a password. The link is valid for 7 days. The address must not already be a Meesam login.
staff.cutover: {n} staff role(s) still sit on a customer login. They end automatically the moment a System Administrator activates a separate staff login.

errors.emailTaken: This e-mail address is already a Meesam login. A staff login needs its own address.
errors.lastAdmin: The last active System Administrator cannot be removed.
errors.self: You cannot remove your own staff login.
errors.mail: The staff login was created but the invitation could not be sent. Use Send invitation again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

agencies.title: Agencies
agencies.sub: The agencies acting for you, and Meesam's directory of verified agencies. You choose which trademarks each agency manages; you can end an appointment at any time.
agencies.none: No agency is acting for you
agencies.noneBody: You manage your trademarks yourself. To hand some or all of them to an agency, appoint one from the directory below.
agencies.directorySub: Verified agency offices that chose to be listed. Meesam does not rank or recommend agencies.
agencies.directoryEmptyBody: Agencies appear here once they are verified and choose to be listed.
agencies.needRecord: Add a trademark first; an appointment always covers at least one trademark.

clients.title: Clients
clients.sub: Owners who appointed your office, and requests waiting for your answer. You see a client's trademarks only while the appointment is in force.
clients.recordsOffered: Trademarks offered: {n}. You can open them once you accept.
clients.adminAnswers: Only the office administrator or an agent can answer requests.
clients.noneBody: Owners find your office in Meesam's directory once you list it (Account, Directory listing).
clients.noRecords: No trademark is in scope at the moment.
clients.inviteSub: Enter your client's e-mail address. If the owner already has a Meesam account, they receive your appointment request. If not, they receive a link to create an account, and your request reaches them once the account is verified. The owner chooses which trademarks your office manages.

links.endNote: When you end the appointment the agency loses access to these trademarks immediately. The trademarks and their documents stay with you.
links.endNoteAgency: When the appointment ends your office loses access to this client's trademarks immediately.

saved.requested: Request sent. The other side has been notified.
saved.scope: Trademarks updated. The agency has been notified.
saved.invited: Invitation sent by e-mail. Your request reaches the owner once their account is verified.

errors.noRecordsEnd: An appointment covers at least one trademark. To remove them all, end the appointment.
errors.alreadyOpen: There is already an open request or appointment with this account.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.inviteOpen: Your office already has an invitation waiting for this address.
errors.notOwner: This address cannot be invited as an owner.
errors.inviteLimit: Your office has reached the limit of invitations for today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.inviteMail: The invitation was recorded but the e-mail could not be sent. Withdraw it and send it again.

users.title: Users
users.sub: The people who can log in to this account, and what each may do. Each person has their own login; an e-mail address belongs to one Meesam account only.

can.company_admin: manages users, roles and the account details; everything a Trademark manager can do.
can.tm_manager: adds and edits records, documents and certificate information; starts filing requests; appoints an agency.
can.agency_admin: manages users, roles and the office details; everything an Agent can do.
can.agent: adds and edits records for the office's clients; answers appointment requests.
can.viewer: reads records and downloads documents only.

users.removeNote: Suspending or removing a user logs them out at once. Everything they did stays in the records' history.
users.inviteSub: The person receives an e-mail with a link to choose a password. The link is valid for 7 days.

errors.emailTaken: This e-mail address already belongs to a Meesam account. A person can belong to one account only.
errors.lastAdmin: The account must keep at least one active administrator.
errors.self: You cannot change the role of, suspend or remove your own login.
errors.mail: The user was added but the invitation e-mail could not be sent. Use "Send invitation again".
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

users.ownRole: Your own role is changed by another administrator of the account.

invite.title: Join your team on Meesam
invite.intro: Hello {name}. You were invited to join {account} on Meesam with the e-mail {email}. Choose a password to activate your login.
invite.bad: This invitation link has already been used or has expired. If you have already chosen your password, log in with your e-mail and that password. Otherwise ask your account administrator to send the invitation again.
invite.signedInAs: This browser is signed in as {name} ({email}). To use a different login, log out first.

otherAccount.title: This link is for another account
otherAccount.body: The e-mail you opened was sent to a different Meesam account. This browser is signed in as {name} ({email}). Log out, then log in with the account the e-mail was sent to.

pass.title: Owner pass
pass.bad: This pass is not valid, has already been used or has expired. Ask the agency to issue a new one.
pass.agency: This pass is for the trademark owner. This browser is signed in as {name} ({email}), an agency account.
pass.intro: {agency} entered this trademark in Meesam for you. Redeeming the pass attaches it to your own account.
pass.confirm: The trademark will be attached to {account} ({email}). {agency} will go on managing it for you; you can end that at any time under Agencies.
pass.notVerified: Your account must be verified before a pass can be redeemed. Come back to this link once it is.
pass.signIn: Log in, or create an owner account. Meesam keeps this pass and brings you back to it afterwards.
pass.panelSub: If your agency gave you a pass code for a trademark it entered for you, enter it here to attach the trademark to your account.
pass.done: The trademark is now attached to your account. {agency} goes on managing it; you can end that under Agencies.
pass.switch: To attach this trademark, continue with the owner's account. Meesam logs this account out, keeps the pass, and brings you back to it after you log in.
pass.switchButton: Log out and continue as the owner
pass.waiting: An owner pass is waiting: {mark}, entered by {agency}.
pass.waitingLink: Open the pass to attach the trademark
